CommunityApplications.Profile:
NovaCortex is self-hosted, MCP-native long-term memory for AI agents — typed memories (episodic, semantic, procedural, working), semantic vector search, a relation graph and a knowledge base, all running on your own hardware. Agents talk to it over MCP (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code), REST, the CLI or the TypeScript/Python SDKs.
This repository ships the Unraid distribution of NovaCortex:
- **Full stack (recommended):** `docker-compose.unraid.yml` runs SurrealDB, Qdrant, Redis, the NovaCortex API and the Web UI together via the **Docker Compose Manager** plugin. An optional `local-ai` profile adds an Ollama sidecar so embeddings and memory intelligence run fully offline — no memory text ever leaves the server. - **Single containers:** the templates under `templates/unraid/` install the NovaCortex Web UI or API on their own, for people who already run their own SurrealDB / Qdrant / Redis containers or a NovaCortex API elsewhere.
Everything is Apache-2.0 and the free tier needs no license key or account. Images are published to GHCR at `ghcr.io/nova-cognitive-systems/novacortex-{api,web}`.
Support: https://github.com/Nova-Cognitive-Systems/novacortex/issues
